title: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents
authors_zh: Yifan Xu, Xiao Liu, Xinghan Liu, Jiaqi Fu, Hanchen Zhang, Bohao Jing, Shudan Zhang, Yuting Wang, Wenyi Zhao, Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: 移动 GUI 智能体在线强化学习 recipe 与混合 verifier 研究
best_for_zh: 研究移动端 agentic RL、轨迹 replay、失败筛选、终局 reward 与可复现 Android 环境的读者
one_line: MobileRL combines 97.9k action-only SFT steps, 23.6k reasoning-SFT steps, and online Android rollouts over 3,103 training tasks with mixed terminal verification, length shaping, positive replay, and failure filtering.
MobileRL 用 97.9k 步 action-only SFT、23.6k 步 reasoning SFT 和 3,103 个在线 Android 训练任务构建移动端 RL pipeline，并以混合终局 verifier、路径长度 shaping、正向 replay 和失败课程控制轨迹分布，但训练代码、数据和 replay 尚未发布。
why: It turns the trajectory distribution itself into a dynamic post-training object: scarce difficult successes are replayed, low-advantage failures are pruned, repeatedly unsolved tasks are removed, and two different verifier regimes determine which mobile behaviors receive policy gradients.
inclusion_reason: MobileRL makes trajectory selection and task sampling part of the learning signal: online Android episodes receive programmatic or learned terminal outcomes, SPA length shaping, AdaPR positive replay, negative pruning, and FCF failure-driven curriculum decisions. It belongs in the environment-agent track because environment state, action history, verifier type, replay policy, and dropped failures jointly determine what behavior is reinforced.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MobileRL is a 2025 arXiv preprint about online reinforcement learning for mobile GUI agents. This Card uses arXiv:2509.18119v2, submitted on 2025-09-10 and revised on 2025-10-24, together with the official THUDM/MobileRL repository and xuyifan/MobileRL-9B checkpoint. The repository HEAD inspected on 2026-07-20 is 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1; it contains evaluation code, not the training pipeline or rollout data.

The problem is not merely predicting the next tap. Online mobile RL must obtain rare successes from expensive Android emulators, cope with a heavy-tailed task-difficulty distribution, and assign useful credit to multi-turn trajectories whose reward arrives only at completion. Uniform on-policy sampling repeatedly spends compute on impossible tasks and discards scarce difficult successes, while action-only imitation does not teach recovery from the policy's own errors.

MobileRL treats training as three linked data objects. Reasoning-free SFT uses 97.9k action steps: 21.3k AndroidControl-Low, 14.3k AndroidControl-High, and 62.2k human-annotation/self-exploration steps. Reasoning SFT uses 23.6k steps from the same groups—7.2k, 4.1k, and 12.2k—with model-generated reasoning retained only when the action matches the expert target. Online RL then samples state-action trajectories over 2,000 AndroidWorld and 1,103 AndroidLab training tasks.

An RL episode binds a natural-language instruction and initial Android state to repeated screenshot/compressed-XML observations, optional reasoning, structured GUI actions, environment transitions, a terminal Finish or 50-turn cutoff, and a binary outcome. AndroidWorld supplies rule-based verifiable rewards. AndroidLab's generated training tasks lack ground-truth tests, so a learned VLM reward model judges the complete screenshot/action trace. SPA length shaping, AdaPR replay selection, negative pruning, and FCF task failure histories then determine which trajectory tokens receive policy gradients.

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the environment, rollout, terminal verifier, replay buffer, and dropped failures jointly define the supervision. The paper evidences SFT, RLVR on rule-verifiable AndroidWorld tasks, and mobile agent training. It does not release the SFT corpora, 3,103 RL tasks, training code, AndroidLab reward-model data/checkpoint, replay state, or complete successful and failed rollouts. The current evidence supports L4-depth analysis but retains L3_summary_ready and partial workflow status.

MobileRL 是一篇研究移动 GUI 智能体在线强化学习的 2025 年 arXiv preprint。本卡以 2025-09-10 提交、2025-10-24 修订的 arXiv:2509.18119v2 为论文基线，并核验官方 THUDM/MobileRL 仓库与 xuyifan/MobileRL-9B checkpoint。2026-07-20 检查的仓库 HEAD 为 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1；当前仓库提供 evaluation code，而非训练 pipeline 或 rollout 数据。

论文要解决的不只是预测下一次点击。移动端 online RL 需要从昂贵 Android emulator 中获得稀缺成功轨迹，应对 heavy-tailed task difficulty，并给只在任务结束时收到 reward 的多轮 trajectory 分配有效 credit。uniform on-policy sampling 会反复在不可解任务上消耗 compute，又会丢掉稀缺的困难成功样本；action-only imitation 也无法学习从策略自身错误中恢复。

MobileRL 把训练拆成三个相连的数据对象。Reasoning-free SFT 共 97.9k action step：AndroidControl-Low 21.3k、AndroidControl-High 14.3k、human annotation/self-exploration 62.2k。Reasoning SFT 从相同来源使用 23.6k step——7.2k、4.1k 与 12.2k——只有 action 与 expert target 匹配的模型 reasoning 才保留。online RL 随后在 2,000 个 AndroidWorld 与 1,103 个 AndroidLab training task 上采样 state-action trajectory。

一条 RL episode 把自然语言 instruction 与 Android initial state 连接到连续 screenshot/compressed-XML observation、可选 reasoning、结构化 GUI action、environment transition、Finish 或 50-turn cutoff，以及 binary outcome。AndroidWorld 提供 rule-based verifiable reward；AndroidLab 生成的训练任务没有 ground-truth test，因而由 learned VLM reward model 判断完整 screenshot/action trace。SPA length shaping、AdaPR replay selection、negative pruning 与 FCF task failure history 共同决定哪些 trajectory token 获得 policy gradient。

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 environment、rollout、terminal verifier、replay buffer 与被删除的 failure 共同定义 supervision。论文明确支持 SFT、在 AndroidWorld rule-verifiable task 上的 RLVR，以及 mobile agent training；但没有发布 SFT corpus、3,103 个 RL task、训练代码、AndroidLab reward-model data/checkpoint、replay state 或完整成功／失败 rollout。现有证据足以写成 L4 深度正文，但 workflow 仍保持 L3_summary_ready 与 partial。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is Difficulty-Adaptive GRPO (AdaGRPO), which makes the online trajectory distribution an adaptive training signal rather than a passive stream. A warmed-up policy generates groups of Android episodes; binary terminal outcomes are adjusted for path length; high-advantage successes can enter a replay buffer; low-advantage trajectories are pruned; and tasks with repeated all-zero groups are cooled down and eventually removed.

The state-action object is concrete. At turn t, the policy observes the current device screenshot and compressed XML accessibility hierarchy together with the original instruction, then emits reasoning and one of Tap, Type, Swipe, Long Press, Launch, Back, Home, Wait, or Finish. Android OS/application dynamics produce the next screen and XML state. An episode ends at Finish in a successful state or the 50-turn horizon; choosing Finish alone is not the success verifier.

The feedback contract is mixed. AndroidWorld training instances expose rule-based success checks. AndroidLab's 1,103 generated training tasks do not have those tests, so strong proprietary VLMs label full screenshot/action traces, a GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model is fine-tuned on several thousand such labels, and the selected model reaches 86% accuracy on 1,000 verified traces. The learned verifier observes the task, screenshot sequence, XML/page states, and actions, but its binary label cannot guarantee absence of collateral or unsafe actions and inherits teacher/judge bias.

SPA rescales only successful trajectories using their length relative to the shortest success for the same task group; early failed termination remains zero. AdaPR inserts the top advantage fraction into a 256-entry replay buffer and mixes selected replay with fresh on-policy data. Negative pruning caps the positive-to-negative ratio at 1:2 by discarding low-advantage negatives. FCF sends a task with two consecutive all-zero epochs into a three-epoch cooldown with sampling weight exp(-f) and removes it if failure persists.

Compared with offline mobile imitation such as DigiRL or offline DPO/action datasets, MobileRL trains on closed-loop consequences of the current policy. Compared with single-step GUI RL, it optimizes full multi-turn episodes. The novelty is not GRPO, replay, or curriculum separately; it is their task-difficulty-aware integration with expensive parallel Android sampling. Its audit boundary is equally important: the official release contains evaluation code and a checkpoint, not the adaptive training records that determine the claimed data efficiency.

核心贡献是 Difficulty-Adaptive GRPO（AdaGRPO）：它不把 online trajectory 当作被动数据流，而是让 trajectory distribution 本身随训练动态变化。warm-up policy 在 Android 环境中生成 episode group；terminal binary outcome 按路径长度调整；high-advantage success 可进入 replay buffer；low-advantage trajectory 被剪除；持续产生全零 reward 的任务则降采样并最终移除。

state-action 对象很具体。每个 turn，policy 同时观察当前 device screenshot、compressed XML accessibility hierarchy 与原始 instruction，再输出 reasoning 及 Tap、Type、Swipe、Long Press、Launch、Back、Home、Wait 或 Finish。Android OS/application dynamics 产生下一屏与 XML state。episode 在 successful state 中选择 Finish 或到达 50-turn horizon 时结束；单独选择 Finish 并不构成 success verifier。

反馈契约是 mixed。AndroidWorld training instance 具有 rule-based success check。AndroidLab 的 1,103 个生成训练任务没有对应 test，因此先由 strong proprietary VLM 给完整 screenshot/action trace 打标签，再用这些标签微调 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model；入选版本在 1,000 条 verified trace 上达到 86% accuracy。该 learned verifier 能看到 task、screenshot sequence、XML/page state 与 action，但 binary label 不能保证没有 collateral/unsafe action，并可能继承 teacher/judge bias。

SPA 只对成功 trajectory 按其长度相对于同任务组最短成功路径进行缩放；过早失败仍为零。AdaPR 把 top-advantage fraction 放入 256-entry replay buffer，并把选中 replay 与 fresh on-policy data 混合。negative pruning 通过丢弃低 advantage negative，把 positive-to-negative ratio 限在 1:2。FCF 对连续两个 epoch 全零的任务执行三 epoch cooldown，sampling weight 为 exp(-f)，持续失败后永久移除。

与 DigiRL 等 offline mobile imitation 或 offline DPO/action dataset 相比，MobileRL 从 current policy 的 closed-loop consequence 学习；与 single-step GUI RL 相比，它优化完整多轮 episode。真正的变化不是单独发明 GRPO、replay 或 curriculum，而是把它们按 task difficulty 集成进昂贵的并行 Android sampling。审计边界同样重要：官方 release 只有 evaluation code 与 checkpoint，没有决定 sample efficiency 的 adaptive training record。

title: Method
方法
html:
The current arXiv v2 pipeline can be reconstructed conceptually as follows.

  1. Reasoning-free SFT. AndroidControl training records are converted to MobileRL's screenshot/XML and bounding-box action format and combined with sanitized human-annotation/model-exploration records. The stage contains 97.9k action steps: 21.3k AndroidControl-Low, 14.3k AndroidControl-High, and 62.2k human-origin steps.
  2. Reasoning SFT. An undisclosed off-the-shelf Instruct model samples reasoning-action candidates. A candidate is retained only when its action matches the expert action; an initial reasoning policy is trained, then generates new candidates whose best correct explanation is added iteratively. The final 23.6k-step corpus—7.2k, 4.1k, and 12.2k by the same source groups—is trained for two epochs.
  3. RL task construction and split controls. AndroidWorld task templates vary substitutable content and initial states; instances with the same specific content and initial state as any of 116 test tasks are removed, leaving 2,000 training tasks. AndroidLab applications generate candidate tasks that humans check for feasibility and non-overlap with 138 test tasks, yielding 1,103 training tasks. This is an exact/manual split defense, not a semantic or pretraining-contamination audit.
  4. Online interaction. Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct or GLM-4.1V-9B-Base, after the two SFT stages, observes a screenshot plus compressed XML and produces structured GUI actions. XML preprocessing removes off-screen/redundant nodes, simplifies attributes, merges text/content descriptions, and retains bounds. Rollout settings are temperature 1.0, 16 samples per task group, 4,096 maximum new tokens, and 50 turns.
  5. Terminal verification. AndroidWorld returns a rule-based binary success reward. For AndroidLab training tasks, several medium-capability agents generate traces; three strong proprietary VLM judgments are majority-voted for training items, with reasoning retained. A GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model is fine-tuned on several thousand labels and selected at 86% accuracy on a verified 1,000-trace set.
  6. Reward transformation and selection. SPA with alpha=1.0 down-weights longer successful paths relative to the shortest success and leaves failures at zero. Group-relative advantages drive GRPO. AdaPR uses buffer size 256, gamma=1.0, and kappa=0.25 to retain top-advantage trajectories. Low-advantage negatives are randomly pruned to keep at most a 1:2 positive-to-negative ratio. FCF cools down and then removes persistently all-zero tasks.
  7. Optimization and infrastructure. The Verl-based setup uses FSDP, learning rate 1e-6, train/validation batch size 256, PPO micro-batch size 4 per GPU, one PPO epoch, gradient clip 1.0, clip ratio 0.2, and KL coefficient 0.001. Four rollout machines each provide 1 TB RAM; each AVD needs over 5 GB memory and 30 GB storage. The system stably sustains up to 256 parallel rollouts, with a step taking over 10 minutes and 100 training steps over 25 hours.

The official repository currently supplies an AgentRL-based evaluation stack, Docker configurations/images, AndroidLab evaluation code, and pinned patched AndroidWorld dependencies. Reproducing training still requires the unreleased corpora/tasks, teacher manifests, reward model, rollout/replay records, training implementation, AVD/APK versions, seeds, optimizer state, and paper-era environment/result manifests.

当前 arXiv v2 pipeline 可在概念层按以下流程重建。

  1. Reasoning-free SFT。 AndroidControl training record 被转换为 MobileRL 的 screenshot/XML 与 bounding-box action 格式，再与经过 sanitation 的 human-annotation/model-exploration record 合并。总计 97.9k action step：AndroidControl-Low 21.3k、AndroidControl-High 14.3k、human-origin 62.2k。
  2. Reasoning SFT。 未披露身份的 off-the-shelf Instruct model 采样 reasoning-action candidate；只有 action 与 expert action 相同的 candidate 被保留。先训练 initial reasoning policy，再迭代产生新 candidate，把其中正确且最优的 explanation 加回数据。最终 23.6k-step corpus 按同一来源分为 7.2k、4.1k、12.2k，训练两个 epoch。
  3. RL task 构造与 split control。 AndroidWorld template 通过替换内容与 initial state 生成任务；与 116 个 test task 在具体内容和初态上相同的 instance 被删除，得到 2,000 个 training task。AndroidLab application 自动生成 candidate，人工核查 feasibility 与相对 138 个 test task 的 non-overlap，得到 1,103 个 training task。这是 exact/manual split defense，不是 semantic 或 pretraining-contamination audit。
  4. Online interaction。 两阶段 SFT 后的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 或 GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 接收 screenshot 与 compressed XML，输出结构化 GUI action。XML preprocessing 删除 off-screen/redundant node，简化 attribute，合并 text/content description 并保留 bounds。rollout 使用 temperature 1.0、每个 task group 16 个 sample、max new tokens 4,096、最多 50 turn。
  5. Terminal verification。 AndroidWorld 返回 rule-based binary success。AndroidLab 先让多种 medium-capability agent 产生 trace，再由三个 strong proprietary VLM judgment majority-vote；training item 保留 reasoning。若干千条 label 用于微调 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model，最终选择在 1,000 条 verified trace 上为 86% 的版本。
  6. Reward transformation 与 selection。 SPA 以 alpha=1.0 相对同任务最短成功路径降低较长成功路径的 reward，failure 保持零。group-relative advantage 驱动 GRPO。AdaPR 使用 buffer size 256、gamma=1.0 与 kappa=0.25 保留 top-advantage trajectory。low-advantage negative 被随机剪除，使 positive-to-negative ratio 不超过 1:2；FCF 对持续全零任务 cooldown 后移除。
  7. Optimization 与 infrastructure。 Verl-based setup 使用 FSDP、learning rate 1e-6、train/validation batch 256、每 GPU PPO micro-batch 4、一个 PPO epoch、gradient clip 1.0、clip ratio 0.2、KL coefficient 0.001。四台 rollout machine 各有 1 TB RAM；每个 AVD 需要超过 5 GB memory 与 30 GB storage。系统稳定支持最多 256 个 parallel rollout，每个 step 超过 10 分钟，100 个 training step 超过 25 小时。

官方仓库目前提供 AgentRL-based evaluation stack、Docker configuration/image、AndroidLab evaluation code，以及固定并 patch 的 AndroidWorld dependency。训练复现仍缺 SFT corpus/task、teacher manifest、reward model、rollout/replay record、training implementation、AVD/APK version、seed、optimizer state 与 paper-era environment/result manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the full-resolution arXiv v2 setting, MobileRL with Qwen2.5-VL-7B reaches 72.0% success on AndroidWorld and 42.5% on AndroidLab. MobileRL with GLM-4.1V-9B-Base reaches 80.2% and 53.6%, respectively. Table 1 compares these with V-Droid at 59.5%/38.3%, UI-Tars-1.5 at 64.2%/38.3%, and UI-Genie-Agent at 41.2% on AndroidLab. These are author-reported success rates in the specified emulator/judge setup, not independent reproduction or data-quality certification.

The staged ablation separates initialization from online RL. Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct starts at 27.6%/10.1%, rises to 50.2%/36.9% after reasoning-free SFT, 56.8%/38.7% after reasoning SFT, and 72.0%/42.5% after AdaGRPO. GLM-4.1V-9B-Base starts at 7.7%/10.1%, then reaches 48.1%/42.7%, 66.2%/45.0%, and 80.2%/53.6%. The large SFT gains mean the final score cannot be attributed to online RL alone.

The AdaGRPO ablation uses the Qwen reasoning-SFT initialization and AndroidWorld's rule-based verifier to avoid AndroidLab reward-model bias. Averaged over three runs, full MobileRL scores 71.1%; removing AdaPR gives 63.6%, removing SPA 69.1%, removing both 58.5%, removing FCF 64.8%, and omitting all AdaGRPO 56.8%. These results support the combined selection recipe under a 100-step compute budget, but do not reveal how many episodes each filter retained or discarded.

Figure 4 reports eight temperature-1.0 trials by AndroidWorld task complexity. Relative pass@k improvements grow on the highest-complexity group, reaching +11.3, +15.7, +19.9, and +24.3 percentage points at pass@1/2/4/8. SPA also wins more often on step count across complexity groups. This is evidence about paper-defined efficiency, not proof that short paths are safer or semantically preferable.

Two negative results constrain interpretation. The learned AndroidLab reward model reaches 86% accuracy on its curated 1,000-trace set, and the authors report less smooth AndroidLab training curves; MobileRL-9B's best result is obtained with RL only on AndroidWorld. Also, Table 6 shows that image resolution changes GLM results: compressed-image MobileRL-9B gives 75.8%/46.8%, while full-resolution images give 80.2%/53.6%. The official evaluation README warns that inference engine, deployment, and compression can cause 1–2 point variation and reports three-run averages.

在 arXiv v2 的 full-resolution setting 下，以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为 backbone 的 MobileRL 在 AndroidWorld/AndroidLab 上为 72.0%/42.5%；以 GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 为 backbone 的 MobileRL 为 80.2%/53.6%。Table 1 中，V-Droid 为 59.5%/38.3%，UI-Tars-1.5 为 64.2%/38.3%，UI-Genie-Agent 在 AndroidLab 为 41.2%。这些是作者在特定 emulator/judge setup 下报告的 success rate，不是独立复现或 data-quality 认证。

staged ablation 把初始化与 online RL 分开。Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 从 27.6%/10.1% 开始，reasoning-free SFT 后为 50.2%/36.9%，reasoning SFT 后为 56.8%/38.7%，AdaGRPO 后为 72.0%/42.5%。GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 从 7.7%/10.1% 提升到 48.1%/42.7%、66.2%/45.0%，最后为 80.2%/53.6%。SFT 阶段贡献很大，因此不能把 final score 全部归因于 online RL。

AdaGRPO ablation 使用 Qwen reasoning-SFT initialization 与 AndroidWorld rule-based verifier，以避开 AndroidLab reward-model bias。三次运行平均后，完整 MobileRL 为 71.1%；去掉 AdaPR 为 63.6%，去掉 SPA 为 69.1%，两者都去掉为 58.5%，去掉 FCF 为 64.8%，完全不用 AdaGRPO 为 56.8%。这些结果支持 100-step compute budget 下的组合 selection recipe，但没有披露每个 filter 实际保留或丢弃多少 episode。

Figure 4 按 AndroidWorld task complexity 做八次 temperature-1.0 trial。最高 complexity group 的 pass@1/2/4/8 相对提升分别为 +11.3、+15.7、+19.9、+24.3 个百分点；SPA 在各 complexity group 上也更常用较少 step 完成任务。这是 paper-defined efficiency 的证据，不能证明短路径天然更安全或语义更优。

两个 negative result 限定了结论。AndroidLab learned reward model 在 1,000 条 curated trace 上只有 86% accuracy，且作者报告 AndroidLab training curve 更不平滑；MobileRL-9B 最优结果来自只使用 AndroidWorld 的 RL。Table 6 还显示 image resolution 会改变 GLM 结果：compressed image 为 75.8%/46.8%，full-resolution 为 80.2%/53.6%。官方 evaluation README 提醒 inference engine、deployment 与 compression 会造成常见 1–2 point 波动，并以三次独立运行取平均。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is offline mobile-agent post-training: action-only demonstrations, static screenshots, offline RL, or DPO over fixed records. Those settings expose expert behavior but not the current policy's closed-loop errors, recovery attempts, or environment-dependent success. Single-step GUI RL likewise does not address credit across a 50-turn interaction or the cost of running many Android devices.

MobileRL changes both the data object and selection rule. Its RL record is a live screenshot/XML/action trajectory with a terminal outcome, a length-sensitive reward, a group-relative advantage, possible replay membership, and a task failure history. AdaPR gives scarce difficult successes another update; FCF changes the task distribution using repeated all-zero groups; negative pruning explicitly discards low-advantage failures. Thus, “the dataset” is not a fixed file but a policy- and verifier-dependent stream whose membership evolves during optimization.

The feedback interface is also deliberately heterogeneous. AndroidWorld uses executable rule-based checks; AndroidLab training relies on a learned VLM judge distilled from proprietary-majority labels. The paper's comparison of smoother AndroidWorld learning and less reliable AndroidLab rewards makes verifier quality part of the method rather than a hidden benchmark detail.

Individual components are not unprecedented: two-stage SFT, GRPO, experience replay, curricula, length shaping, VLM judges, Dockerized emulators, and bounding-box actions all have prior art. The contribution is their integration for expensive multi-turn Android sampling, plus explicit per-task difficulty adaptation. The reported ability to orchestrate many AVDs is a systems contribution, not evidence that selected trajectories are unbiased or reusable.

For reasoning-data research, the work is directionally important because it makes an often-hidden choice auditable: which successes are replayed and which failures/tasks disappear. Before reuse, a team must inspect selection-induced coverage loss, reward-model errors, split/overlap controls, replay and removal logs, environment versioning, and data rights. The released evaluation code and checkpoint do not expose those training-time decisions.

最接近的 baseline 是 offline mobile-agent post-training：action-only demonstration、static screenshot、offline RL 或针对固定 record 的 DPO。这些方法能展示 expert behavior，却看不到 current policy 的 closed-loop error、recovery attempt 与 environment-dependent success；single-step GUI RL 也没有解决 50-turn interaction 的 credit assignment 与大规模 Android device 成本。

MobileRL 同时改变 data object 与 selection rule。其 RL record 是带 terminal outcome、length-sensitive reward、group-relative advantage、可能的 replay membership 和 task failure history 的 live screenshot/XML/action trajectory。AdaPR 让稀缺困难 success 再次进入 update；FCF 按重复全零 group 改变 task distribution；negative pruning 明确丢弃 low-advantage failure。因此，“dataset”不是静态文件，而是随 policy 与 verifier 演化的数据流。

反馈接口也有意保持异构：AndroidWorld 使用 executable rule-based check，AndroidLab training 使用从 proprietary-majority label 蒸馏出的 learned VLM judge。论文对 AndroidWorld 更平滑、AndroidLab reward 更不可靠的比较，使 verifier quality 成为方法的一部分，而不是隐藏的 benchmark 细节。

各组件并非都由本文首创：two-stage SFT、GRPO、experience replay、curriculum、length shaping、VLM judge、Dockerized emulator 与 bounding-box action 都有先例。贡献是将它们集成到昂贵的多轮 Android sampling，并显式按 task difficulty 调整。编排大量 AVD 是 systems contribution，不代表选中的 trajectory 没有 bias 或可以安全复用。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，论文的重要方向信号是把常被隐藏的选择公开为研究对象：哪些 success 被 replay，哪些 failure/task 消失。复用前必须检查 selection-induced coverage loss、reward-model error、split/overlap control、replay/removal log、environment versioning 与 data rights。发布的 evaluation code 和 checkpoint 并未暴露这些训练时决定。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Training artifacts are incomplete. The official repository at inspected HEAD exposes evaluation, AndroidLab support, scripts, Docker configuration, and patches, but not the paper's SFT data, 3,103 RL tasks, training implementation, AndroidLab reward model/data, replay buffer, failure histories, or full rollout corpus. The Hugging Face artifact is a model checkpoint, not a trajectory release.
  • Learned-verifier error. The AndroidLab reward model reports 86% accuracy on 1,000 verified traces, so 14% are misclassified on that set; no confusion matrix, class-conditional rate, adversarial suite, or independent calibration is released. Proprietary VLM majority labels may share correlated bias.
  • Reward and selection gaming. SPA can reward a short verifier-satisfying shortcut if the terminal checker misses collateral changes or unsafe actions. AdaPR amplifies judged successes; negative pruning and FCF remove low-reward behavior/tasks. These mechanisms can reduce failure diversity and hide systematic hard cases even when aggregate success rises.
  • Best-result scope differs by backbone. Qwen benefits from mixed AndroidWorld/AndroidLab RL, whereas the reported best MobileRL-9B is trained only on AndroidWorld because the learned AndroidLab reward is less reliable. A single “MobileRL” score therefore does not identify one common task mixture or verifier regime.
  • Limited decontamination. AndroidWorld removes exact task-content plus initial-state collisions; AndroidLab uses manual test non-overlap verification. No semantic/template deduplication, cross-source overlap, or evaluated-model pretraining contamination analysis is reported.
  • Version sensitivity. Full-resolution MobileRL-9B scores 80.2%/53.6%; compressed images score 75.8%/46.8%. The evaluation README expects 1–2 point variation from deployment, inference engine, and image compression. APKs, AVD/OS images, random seeds, and paper-era result manifests are not fully pinned in the training release.
  • Representation limits. Compressed XML can omit interactable elements in popular complex apps, while bounding-box grounding depends on accessibility metadata. The authors identify movement toward vision-only interaction as future work.
  • Domain and reset limits. Testing excludes out-of-domain public-use apps because login, VM reliability, manual judgment, and state restoration are difficult. Emulator success does not establish robustness on real devices, unseen UI layouts, authenticated services, or irreversible actions.
  • Resource barrier. Each AVD consumes over 5 GB memory and 30 GB storage; four 1-TB CPU machines stably support only 256 parallel rollouts. A step takes more than 10 minutes and 100 training steps more than 25 hours, limiting independent reproduction and ablation breadth.
  • Privacy evidence is procedural. The paper describes regex masking for textual identifiers and visual masking for faces, QR codes, and OCR text before storage, but publishes no recall/precision audit, residual sensitive-data sample, or annotator consent/compensation record.
  • Mobile security is under-specified. No comprehensive permission, credential, network, prompt-injection, malicious-content, collateral-action, or data-exfiltration evaluation is reported. Emulator isolation does not by itself establish safe deployment.
  • Rights do not transfer automatically. The code is MIT, the model card is Apache-2.0, and the manuscript is CC BY 4.0; these do not establish rights for unreleased screenshots/XML, human annotations, AndroidControl transformations, generated tasks, app content, rollouts, or proprietary-VLM labels.

• 训练 artifact 不完整。 官方仓库在已检查 HEAD 下提供 evaluation、AndroidLab 支持、script、Docker config 与 patch，但没有论文 SFT data、3,103 个 RL task、training implementation、AndroidLab reward model/data、replay buffer、failure history 或完整 rollout corpus。Hugging Face artifact 是 model checkpoint，不是 trajectory release。
  • Learned verifier 有误差。 AndroidLab reward model 在 1,000 条 verified trace 上为 86% accuracy，即该 set 上有 14% 误判；没有 confusion matrix、class-conditional rate、adversarial suite 或 independent calibration。proprietary VLM majority label 可能带来 correlated bias。
  • Reward 与 selection 可能被 gaming。 如果 terminal checker 漏掉 collateral change 或 unsafe action，SPA 会偏好更短的 verifier-satisfying shortcut。AdaPR 放大被判为成功的 episode，negative pruning 与 FCF 则删除低 reward behavior/task；aggregate success 上升时，failure diversity 仍可能下降。
  • 不同 backbone 的 best-result scope 不同。 Qwen 从 AndroidWorld/AndroidLab mixed RL 获益，而 MobileRL-9B 的最佳结果只在 AndroidWorld 上做 RL，因为 learned AndroidLab reward 更不可靠。单一 “MobileRL” 分数不对应唯一 task mixture 或 verifier regime。
  • Decontamination 有限。 AndroidWorld 删除具体 task content 与 initial state 同时相同的冲突；AndroidLab 人工检查 test non-overlap。论文没有 semantic/template deduplication、cross-source overlap 或 evaluated-model pretraining contamination analysis。
  • 版本敏感。 full-resolution MobileRL-9B 为 80.2%/53.6%，compressed image 为 75.8%/46.8%。evaluation README 预计 deployment、inference engine 与 image compression 会造成 1–2 point 变化；training release 没有完整固定 APK、AVD/OS image、random seed 与 paper-era result manifest。
  • 表示限制。 compressed XML 可能漏掉热门复杂 app 的可交互 element，bounding-box grounding 也依赖 accessibility metadata。作者把转向 vision-only interaction 留作 future work。
  • Domain 与 reset 限制。 由于 login、VM reliability、manual judgment 与 state restoration 困难，论文不测试 out-of-domain public-use app。emulator success 不能证明在 real device、unseen UI、authenticated service 或 irreversible action 上可靠。
  • 资源门槛。 每个 AVD 占用超过 5 GB memory 与 30 GB storage；四台 1-TB CPU machine 只能稳定支持 256 个 parallel rollout。每 step 超过 10 分钟，100 个 training step 超过 25 小时，限制独立复现与 ablation breadth。
  • Privacy 证据只是流程描述。 论文说明对文本 identifier 做 regex masking，对 face、QR code 与 OCR text 做 visual masking，但没有公布 recall/precision audit、residual sensitive-data sample 或 annotator consent/compensation record。
  • 移动端 security 披露不足。 没有完整 permission、credential、network、prompt-injection、malicious-content、collateral-action 或 data-exfiltration evaluation。emulator isolation 本身不能证明 deployment 安全。
  • Rights 不会自动传递。 code 为 MIT、model card 为 Apache-2.0、manuscript 为 CC BY 4.0；这些许可不能证明未发布 screenshot/XML、human annotation、AndroidControl transformation、generated task、app content、rollout 或 proprietary-VLM label 的 rights。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
MobileRL is useful to the environment-agent track as a concrete recipe for connecting data construction, online behavior, verifier choice, and optimizer sampling. A reproduction plan can implement the three stages separately: action-only SFT, action-matched reasoning augmentation, then grouped mobile rollouts with environment-specific terminal checks. Logging each stage separately prevents final benchmark gains from being attributed only to RL.

AdaPR and FCF provide reusable experimental baselines for trajectory-data selection. Log every candidate episode with task ID, policy/environment version, terminal outcome, path length, SPA reward, advantage, replay selection, pruning decision, failure count, cooldown/removal status, and subsequent reuse count. Compare the paper's policy against uniform on-policy sampling, replay without difficulty control, failure retention, and balanced hard-case sampling. Coverage and verifier-error metrics should accompany sample-efficiency gains.

The mixed feedback contract supports verifier research. AndroidWorld can serve as a rule-based anchor for measuring the AndroidLab learned judge. Researchers can create paired traces with the same terminal result but different collateral actions, unsafe permissions, redundant steps, or visual/XML ambiguity; then report false positives and false negatives before using judge labels for RL. The paper's 86% accuracy is a starting point, not a sufficient safety threshold.

The official evaluation repository is usable for version-pinned AndroidWorld/AndroidLab testing, and MobileRL-9B can be evaluated from the Hugging Face checkpoint. Cite repository HEAD 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1 and model revision 3415b64eb7ba1289475d7a93e96a26276f644ba9; record image resolution and inference engine because the official materials document sensitivity.

Reuse class is evaluation/model-inference reuse for released artifacts; training-recipe reference with reproduction blocked pending release. The paper supports SFT, rule-verifiable RLVR, and agent training as intended uses, but neither code/model license covers the unreleased training records. Training reuse requires the corpora, tasks, reward model, full success/failure rollouts, replay/filter logs, immutable environments, rights, privacy audit, and security controls.

对 environment-agent track，MobileRL 是一套把 data construction、online behavior、verifier choice 与 optimizer sampling 连起来的具体 recipe。复现可把 action-only SFT、action-matched reasoning augmentation、带环境特定 terminal check 的 grouped mobile rollout 分阶段实现并分别记录，避免把 final benchmark gain 全部归因于 RL。

AdaPR 与 FCF 可作为 trajectory-data selection 的实验 baseline。每条 candidate episode 应记录 task ID、policy/environment version、terminal outcome、path length、SPA reward、advantage、replay selection、pruning decision、failure count、cooldown/removal status 与 reuse count。可对照 uniform on-policy sampling、无 difficulty control 的 replay、failure retention 与 balanced hard-case sampling；sample-efficiency gain 必须同时报告 coverage 与 verifier-error metric。

mixed feedback contract 适合 verifier 研究。AndroidWorld 可作为 rule-based anchor 来校准 AndroidLab learned judge。研究者可以构造 terminal result 相同、但 collateral action、unsafe permission、redundant step 或 visual/XML ambiguity 不同的 paired trace，再报告 false positive/false negative 后用于 RL。论文的 86% accuracy 只是起点，不是足够的 safety threshold。

官方 evaluation 仓库可用于固定版本的 AndroidWorld/AndroidLab 测试，MobileRL-9B 也可从 Hugging Face checkpoint 评测。使用时应固定 repository HEAD 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1 与 model revision 3415b64eb7ba1289475d7a93e96a26276f644ba9，并记录 image resolution 与 inference engine，因为官方材料已证明结果对此敏感。

复用等级是已发布 artifact 可用于 evaluation/model inference；training recipe 可参考，但训练复现需等待 release。论文明确支持 SFT、rule-verifiable RLVR 与 agent training；然而 code/model license 不覆盖未发布训练记录。训练复用前需要 corpus、task、reward model、完整成功／失败 rollout、replay/filter log、immutable environment、rights、privacy audit 与 security control。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use current arXiv v2 counts: 97.9k reasoning-free SFT steps, 23.6k reasoning-SFT steps, 2,000 AndroidWorld RL tasks, and 1,103 AndroidLab RL tasks. The earlier 500k/71.4k wording is not the current paper record.
  • Follow one episode end to end: screenshot plus compressed XML → reasoning/action → Android transition → Finish or 50 turns → rule-based or learned binary outcome → SPA reward → group-relative advantage → replay/prune/filter decision.
  • Read Appendix D.3.2 before treating AndroidLab as verifiable: the reward model is distilled from proprietary-VLM majority labels and reaches 86% on 1,000 verified traces; MobileRL-9B's best RL run uses AndroidWorld only.
  • Interpret 80.2%/53.6% as full-resolution results. Table 6 retains compressed-image results of 75.8%/46.8%, and the evaluation README warns about deployment-related variation.
  • The release boundary matters: GitHub publishes an MIT evaluation framework and Hugging Face publishes an Apache-2.0 checkpoint, but training code/data, reward model, replay buffer, and complete rollouts are absent.
  • Audit what disappears. AdaPR replays high-advantage successes, negative pruning discards failures, and FCF removes repeated all-zero tasks; sample efficiency can improve while behavioral coverage narrows.

• 采用当前 arXiv v2 数字：97.9k reasoning-free SFT step、23.6k reasoning-SFT step、2,000 个 AndroidWorld RL task 与 1,103 个 AndroidLab RL task；早期 500k/71.4k 口径不是当前论文记录。
  • 沿一条 episode 追踪全流程：screenshot + compressed XML → reasoning/action → Android transition → Finish 或 50 turn → rule-based/learned binary outcome → SPA reward → group-relative advantage → replay/prune/filter decision。
  • 把 AndroidLab 当作 verifiable 之前先读 Appendix D.3.2：reward model 从 proprietary-VLM majority label 蒸馏，在 1,000 条 verified trace 上为 86%；MobileRL-9B 的最佳 RL 使用 AndroidWorld only。
  • 80.2%/53.6% 是 full-resolution result；Table 6 保留 compressed-image 的 75.8%/46.8%，evaluation README 还提醒 deployment 会造成波动。
  • release 边界很重要：GitHub 发布 MIT evaluation framework，Hugging Face 发布 Apache-2.0 checkpoint，但 training code/data、reward model、replay buffer 与完整 rollout 均缺失。
  • 审计“哪些数据消失”：AdaPR replay high-advantage success，negative pruning 丢弃 failure，FCF 移除重复全零任务；sample efficiency 可能提高，behavior coverage 也可能收窄。

value.html: A three-stage mobile-agent training recipe combining action-only expert demonstrations, reasoning-augmented SFT records, and online Android state-action trajectories with terminal binary outcomes, length-shaped rewards, replay flags, and task-difficulty histories.

items: task-specific success mechanism or learned reward path

value.html: Reasoning-free and reasoning SFT use AndroidControl plus human-annotated/mobile self-exploration records. Online RL uses 2,000 AndroidWorld training tasks created by varying task content and initial state and 1,103 model-expanded AndroidLab training tasks manually checked for feasibility and test non-overlap.

At every turn the policy receives the current device screenshot and a compressed XML accessibility hierarchy. XML preprocessing removes off-screen or redundant nodes, simplifies attributes, merges text and content descriptions, and retains bounds; this representation can omit interactable elements in some public apps.
Bounding-box-aligned Tap and Long Press, Type, directional Swipe, Launch, Back, Home, Wait, and terminating Finish operations over AndroidLab/AndroidControl-style mobile interfaces.

A multi-turn trajectory of screenshot/XML states, optional reasoning, and structured GUI actions ending in Finish or the 50-turn horizon, followed by an environment or VLM-derived binary outcome and an SPA-shaped reward.

Human annotators and selected model-driven exploration supply action-only demonstrations; an off-the-shelf Instruct model bootstraps and iteratively refines reasoning-action candidates that must match expert actions; the current policy generates online RL rollouts. The identities and revisions of the reasoning bootstrap model and proprietary reward-labeling VLMs are undisclosed.

items: shortest successful length within the task group
FCF task failure count and sampling status
replay-buffer membership or failure history during training

value.html: Interactive AndroidWorld and AndroidLab environments running through hundreds of Dockerized Android virtual devices across multiple machines. The paper reports support for over 1,000 environments but stable concurrent sampling up to 256 rollouts under its hardware setup.

AndroidWorld training tasks use rule-based verifiable rewards. AndroidLab generated training tasks lack ground-truth tests, so a VLM reward model fine-tuned from strong proprietary-VLM majority labels over task descriptions, screenshot sequences, XML/page states, and action descriptions supplies a binary outcome. SPA rescales successful trajectory rewards by relative path length before GRPO.

Binary success/failure at the episode level; AndroidLab's selected GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model reports 86% accuracy on a curated 1,000-trace verified set. SPA converts successful outcomes into length-adjusted scalar rewards, while failures remain zero.

Sparse terminal 0/1 task outcome, transformed for successful trajectories by SPA using the ratio between each path length and the shortest successful path for the task; group-relative advantages are then attached to the trajectory's action tokens for policy optimization.

An episode ends when the agent chooses Finish in a successful state or when the configured horizon is reached; rollout configuration sets a maximum of 50 turns. The reward verifier, rather than Finish alone, determines success.

The official repository currently exposes an MIT-licensed evaluation framework, patched/pinned AndroidWorld dependencies, AndroidLab evaluation code, Docker configuration, and scripts; Hugging Face exposes the MobileRL-9B checkpoint under Apache-2.0. The SFT corpora, 3,103 RL training tasks, training implementation, replay buffer, reward-model checkpoint/data, and complete successful/failed rollout corpus are not released.

AndroidControl and sanitized human/mobile exploration records -> reasoning-free SFT (97.9k steps) -> action-matching reasoning bootstrap and refinement -> reasoning SFT (23.6k steps) -> online rollouts on 2,000 AndroidWorld and 1,103 AndroidLab tasks -> rule-based or learned binary outcome -> SPA reward shaping -> AdaPR positive replay and negative pruning plus FCF task cooldown/removal -> GRPO policy updates.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct for MobileRL-7B and GLM-4.1V-9B-Base for MobileRL-9B.

An undisclosed off-the-shelf Instruct model generates reasoning-action candidates; undisclosed strong proprietary VLMs produce three binary labels and reasoning traces for AndroidLab reward-model training.

Human annotation and model-driven mobile self-exploration create action demonstrations; the Instruct teacher adds reasoning candidates; the warmed-up policy generates online rollouts in AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

AndroidControl training partitions and sanitized human/mobile exploration for SFT; randomized AndroidWorld task templates and initial states for 2,000 RL tasks; model-expanded and manually verified AndroidLab tasks for 1,103 RL tasks.

Online RL samples 16 trajectories per task group at temperature 1.0 with a 50-turn cap and 4,096 maximum new tokens. AndroidWorld complexity analysis uses eight test trials at temperature 1.0; reported test and ablation results are averaged over three runs.
16 samples per RL task group; total generated rollout count and retained/rejected episode counts across training are not disclosed.

Two-stage warm-up followed by AdaGRPO in a Verl-based multi-task, multi-turn framework with Dockerized AVD sampling. Policy input combines screenshot and compressed XML; actions use bounding-box grounding.

AdaPR replay buffer size is 256 with mixture coefficient gamma=1.0 and top-trajectory fraction kappa=0.25. An FCF task with all-zero rewards for two consecutive epochs enters a three-epoch cooldown with weight exp(-f) and is then permanently removed if failure persists.

Reasoning candidates are retained only when their action matches the expert action, then iteratively refined. AndroidLab tasks are manually checked for feasibility and test non-overlap; AndroidWorld training tasks with test-identical content and initial state are removed. AdaPR inserts top-advantage trajectories, negative pruning randomly discards lowest-advantage rollouts to cap the positive-to-negative ratio at 1:2, and FCF down-weights or removes persistently all-zero tasks.

Maximum prompt length 16,384 tokens, maximum response/new-token length 4,096, maximum 50 turns, image bounds 65,536 to 5,000,000 pixels in the reported full-resolution configuration. Stable sampling reached 256 parallel rollouts; the paper reports more than 10 minutes per step and more than 25 hours for 100 training steps.

AdaGRPO/GRPO with FSDP, learning rate 1e-6, PPO micro-batch size 4 per GPU, train/validation batch size 256, one PPO epoch, gradient clipping 1.0, clip ratio 0.2, KL coefficient 0.001, and SPA alpha=1.0.

Reasoning-free SFT has 97.9k steps: AndroidControl Low 21.3k, AndroidControl High 14.3k, and human annotation/self-exploration 62.2k. Reasoning SFT has 23.6k steps: 7.2k, 4.1k, and 12.2k from the same source groups. RL uses 2,000 AndroidWorld and 1,103 AndroidLab tasks; exact rollout counts and mixture schedules by backbone are not released.

AndroidWorld derives 2,000 training tasks after removing instances whose specific content and initial state coincide with 116 evaluation tasks. AndroidLab manually verifies 1,103 generated training tasks for feasibility and non-overlap with 138 evaluation tasks. AndroidControl exposes 74,714 train, 690 validation, and 8,444 test samples, with subsets transformed for the two SFT stages.

AndroidControl training data enters both SFT stages and its distinct test split is used for offline evaluation; AndroidControl is not used in the RL stage. AndroidWorld and AndroidLab provide both constructed training tasks and separate evaluation tasks, making the disclosed split controls central to interpreting results.

The paper reports AndroidWorld removal of exact content-plus-initial-state collisions and manual AndroidLab test non-overlap checks. It does not report semantic/template deduplication, cross-source overlap, evaluated-model pretraining overlap, or contamination checks against other public GUI datasets.

Training uses fresh on-policy trajectories, replays selected high-advantage successes, prunes low-advantage negatives to maintain at most a 1:2 positive-to-negative ratio, and cools down/removes persistently failing tasks. The public artifacts do not retain the complete successful, failed, pruned, replayed, truncated, or removed episode population.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: The AndroidLab reward model reaches 86% accuracy on 1,000 verified traces, leaving a measured 14% error rate on that set and no disclosed class-conditional false-positive/false-negative breakdown.

Strong proprietary VLM majority labels can transfer correlated judge bias into the GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking reward model; the authors explicitly report less stable AndroidLab curves and unsatisfactory cases.
SPA rewards short successful paths but can favor verifier-satisfying shortcuts if the binary terminal judge misses collateral changes, unsafe actions, or incomplete user intent.

AdaPR selectively amplifies high-advantage successes, while negative pruning and FCF suppress failures and persistently unsolved tasks; this improves efficiency but can narrow task/behavior coverage and hide important failure modes.

Screenshot/XML state, app/version drift, emulator timing, image compression, inference engine, and judge/API revisions can change both rollouts and outcomes; the repository warns that 1–2 percentage-point evaluation fluctuations are common.

value.html: The paper describes pre-storage sanitation of screenshots and XML: regex masking of textual identifiers plus face, QR-code, and OCR-text detection/obfuscation in images. Detection accuracy, residual-risk evaluation, annotator recruitment/consent/compensation, and the sanitized corpus itself are not released.

Training/evaluation occurs in Android emulators, but no comprehensive permission, credential, network, malicious-content, prompt-injection, collateral-action, or data-exfiltration audit is reported. Public-use apps with login and unreliable reset are excluded, so real-device safety and state-restoration behavior remain untested.

The arXiv v2 manuscript is CC BY 4.0, the official repository is MIT at inspected HEAD 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1, and the Hugging Face model card marks MobileRL-9B Apache-2.0 at revision 3415b64eb7ba1289475d7a93e96a26276f644ba9. These licenses do not establish reuse rights for unreleased SFT data, RL tasks, rollouts, reward labels, or third-party app content.

Stage-level source counts, task-construction rules, reward paths, and major filtering rules are disclosed. Record-level SFT/task ancestry, teacher request metadata, generated candidate sets, replay membership, failure/removal histories, environment snapshots, and immutable training manifests are not public.

Official repository HEAD 82f3b7e9028098f0683b97dbe228bad300a55fb1 and Hugging Face model revision 3415b64eb7ba1289475d7a93e96a26276f644ba9 were inspected on 2026-07-20. The GitHub repository has no formal release/tag connected to the paper training run and publishes evaluation rather than the paper's training pipeline.

Current arXiv v2 reports full-resolution MobileRL-9B results of 80.2% on AndroidWorld and 53.6% on AndroidLab; Table 6 also preserves earlier compressed-image results of 75.8% and 46.8%. Artifact-based reproduction must state the image-resolution configuration.

items: exact identities, revisions, prompts, decoding settings, and request manifests for the reasoning bootstrap teacher and proprietary reward-labeling VLMs
complete record-level provenance and licenses for human annotations, self-exploration records, transformed AndroidControl items, and generated AndroidLab tasks
complete online rollout counts, replay-buffer contents, per-task difficulty histories, rejection/pruning/removal logs, and policy/environment checkpoints
training implementation, exact paper-era code commit, optimizer state, distributed topology, environment images, APK/app versions, emulator/OS hashes, random seeds, and result manifests
AndroidLab reward-model training data, checkpoint, calibration split, confusion matrix, robustness tests, and independent false-positive/false-negative audit
semantic/template-level cross-source deduplication and evaluated-model pretraining contamination analysis
data- and trajectory-specific reuse terms plus rights for screenshots, XML, app content, and proprietary-VLM labels
privacy-filter recall, residual sensitive-data audit, annotator governance, mobile permission boundaries, and prompt-injection/security evaluation

value.html: verified
high

Treat MobileRL as an evidenced online-training recipe with released evaluation code and a model checkpoint, not as an open trajectory/replay/training-code release. Current v2 supersedes the earlier 500k/71.4k data-count wording and separates full-resolution 80.2/53.6 results from compressed-image 75.8/46.8 results.

high

Training data/code, reward model/data, and trajectory/replay artifacts are not released.
